name: MyReader semantic design tokens
description: Platform-agnostic semantic token source of truth for shared desktop and mobile design semantics.

semantics.primary-action: warm primary color with highest visual prominence
semantics.destructive-action: explicit error hue and confirmation flow
semantics.reading-progress: glanceable and visually subordinate to reading content

platforms.shared: All semantic colors, typography roles, and shared component meaning come from this file.
platforms.desktop: Desktop docs may map these tokens into denser layouts and pointer-first interaction patterns.
platforms.mobile: Mobile docs may map these tokens into touch-first layouts and safe-area aware patterns, but may not redefine the shared semantic values.
